summary: Official FIM motocross games from Milestone's MUD and MXGP titles through the later MXGP official game revival.

entries.title: MUD: FIM Motocross World Championship

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version as primary; emulate console versions only for preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original console fidelity

primary.why: MUD released on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Windows/Steam. It includes MX1 and MX2 championship content, teams, riders, 2011 Monster Energy FIM Motocross of Nations, MUD World Tour, Trick Battle arenas, and online play up to 12 players; Windows/Steam is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC/Steam version at the highest stable settings; use PS3 or Xbox 360 only as console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.

entries.title: MXGP: The Official Motocross Videogame

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version as primary; emulate console/portable versions only for preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original console/portable fidelity

primary.why: The first MXGP game released for Windows, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita, and Xbox 360, based on the 2013 FIM Motocross World Championship with 14 tracks. Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS4 as the best console alternative or Vita only for portable preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.

entries.title: MXGP2: The Official Motocross Videogame

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version as primary; console emulation is only for preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original console fidelity

primary.why: MXGP2 released for Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. It covers the 2015 Motocross World Championship and adds team/rider/bike customization plus MXoN content; Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS4 or Xbox One only as console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Historic-track DLC exists; install owned DLC if preserving every add-on track.

entries.title: MXGP3: The Official Motocross Videogame
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version as primary; Switch/console emulation is only for preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original console/portable fidelity

primary.why: MXGP3 released for Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, with later macOS and Linux ports. It uses Unreal Engine 4, covers the 2016 season, and adds dynamic weather; Windows is the highest-fidelity, best-supported PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use macOS/Linux ports only if needed and Switch only for portable preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: DLC adds extra racing content; install owned DLC if preserving every add-on event or track.
